title: Module files use // comments instead of //! module doc comments
description: In crate-jmap-client, source files error.rs, auth.rs, client.rs, blob.rs, push.rs, sse.rs, and ws/mod.rs all have file-level // line comments instead of //! module doc comments. Without //!, rustdoc produces no per-module documentation page and IDEs show no hover docs for the module. Each file should begin with //! <summary> followed by //! <details> as appropriate.
